authority.source_authority: Logos lifecycle policy remains authoritative; T511 changes validation scheduling only and cannot mutate generated or canonical Scripture data.

non_overlap_statement: The lifecycle writer owns the bounded T511 write set; the regression checker is a deterministic replay phase and cannot edit writer outputs.

roles.why_needed: One integrator must align registry metadata, aggregate scheduling, leaf validator modes, and pytest behavior.
roles.mission: Implement registry-driven clean and release validation without deleting coverage or touching generated data.
roles.authority: May write only T511 allowed paths and may not generate, copy, link, or mutate canonical sidecars.
acceptance_conditions: Clean mode passes with explicit skips.
Release mode fails when declared inputs are absent.
Present parity data still runs existing validators.
stop_conditions: A fix requires Scripture data mutation, validator retirement, CI policy expansion, or mutable cross-worktree data sharing.

readiness_conditions: Focused writer checks pass and the diff stays in T511 scope.

roles.why_needed: The failure recurred because consumers bypassed policy; independent replay must test missing, present, and release states.
roles.mission: Replay clean and simulated-present lifecycle cases and verify no coverage was retired or data mutated.
roles.authority: Read-only deterministic checker; cannot edit code, registry, tests, or data.
acceptance_conditions: All lifecycle state transitions are evidenced.
No generated or canonical path changed.
stop_conditions: Evidence is missing, a test is skipped without registry support, or the checker would need to edit the result.

readiness_conditions: Raw command results and final diff are available.

proof_obligations.description: Prove absent ignored sidecars cause only lifecycle-declared skips and no aggregate or full-pytest failure.
Prove release mode fails before claiming success when any declared generated input is absent.
Prove existing validators remain active and present generated inputs still schedule parity checks.
